messages.author: 00ebeb6e0521112d
messages.subject: unmarked/spOccupancy workshop, Bangkok, Jan 2024
parts:
Dear all,

during January 8-12, 2024, Dusit Ngoprasert, Ngumbang Juat and I will teach the following 5-day workshop at the King Mongkut’s University of Technology in Bangkok, Thailand: "Applied hierarchical modelling of species distribution and abundance with R packages unmarked and spOccupancy"

The workshop will cover static and dynamic occupancy and N-mixture models, occupancy models with species interactions, and distance sampling (all with unmarked) and spatial models of occupancy (with the new spOccupancy package).

Please see the attached flyer for more information about the course and for how to apply.

Best regards -- Marc
